_: FitLog v1.6.0. test_downdays_trend.py runs a real GutLog v3.17.0 beside
the FitLog under test; against the reconstructed FitLog v1.5.0 there is
no reader, no marked bar, a 60-day feed window and no sleep_hours, so

assertions.name: 01 FitLog reads GutLog's down days through the feed
02 the down day's bar is drawn, marked and named
03 mean, low and high leave the down day out
04 the watch feed reaches back 180 days and carries sleep
05 GutLog down degrades to a message
